## Checklist

- [ ] No em dash characters. Plain dash `-` only.
- [ ] Commit messages carry no AI co-author trailer or attribution footer.
- [ ] No hand edits to `CHANGELOG.md` or any auto-generated file.
- [ ] Long Markdown files keep one sentence per line.
- [ ] Lint clean, tests green, no newly skipped or flaky tests.
- [ ] Any simulated or synthetic data added is labeled as such wherever it surfaces.
- [ ] No support score is presented as a probability, and no prototype weight is presented as a scientific claim.
